title: Actions upon reception of the SIB1

entities.name: System Information Block 1
entities.description: The first system information block containing essential cell access and configuration parameters.

entities.name: RedCap UE
entities.description: A reduced capability UE that may have specific restrictions and requirements.

entities.name: RRC_IDLE state
entities.description: RRC state where UE is not connected to the network.

entities.name: RRC_INACTIVE state
entities.description: RRC state where UE maintains connection context but is not actively communicating.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED state
entities.description: RRC state where UE has an active connection with the network.

entities.name: Timer T311
entities.description: Timer used during connection re-establishment procedures.

entities.name: Cell Barred condition
entities.description: Condition where UE considers the cell as barred and cannot access it.

entities.name: servingCellConfigCommon
entities.description: Common configuration parameters for the serving cell.

entities.name: RNA Update procedure
entities.description: RAN-based Notification Area update procedure performed by UE in RRC_INACTIVE state.

entities.name: System Information Acquisition
entities.description: Procedure for acquiring required system information blocks.

relations.description: RedCap UE in specific states may consider cell as barred based on SIB1 parameters.
UE in RRC_INACTIVE state may initiate RNA update if serving cell not in configured notification area.
SIB1 contains servingCellConfigCommon IE with cell configuration parameters.
System information acquisition procedure includes storing and processing SIB1.
Specific UE behavior in RRC_CONNECTED state depends on whether T311 timer is running.
